column1: # mfoil.py's own results: what the JavaScript port of it (src/core/mfoil.js) is held to
# Source: mfoil/mfoil.py in github.com/chrislupp/Scirocco at commit ffb09dc (release 0.2.0,
#   2026-11-15; file sha256 dc5fc9123509bc31...), Krzysztof J. Fidkowski's mfoil, MIT licence;
#   run under Python 3.13 with numpy 2.5.3 and scipy 1.18.1
# measure: computed, by mfoil.py with its own settings (rtol 1e-12, at most 50 Newton iterations)
# section   "NACA xxxx" is mfoil's own NACA geometry (naca_points, 100 points a side, open
#           trailing edge). "tool 4415" is this tool's NACA 4415 (nacaSection('4415'), closed
#           trailing edge) opened to a 1e-4 chord gap by mfoilOpenTrailingEdge, the points the
#           tool analyses; mfoil.py was given those points, its set_coords being replaced
#           (it calls X.shape(1), which does not run).
# warm      yes: the solve started from the previous row's boundary layer (oper.initbl False)
# converged no: mfoil.py stopped at 50 iterations; kept to show the port fails where it fails
# xtr       transition, x/c, on the lower and upper surface; 0 where there is none
